_meta.legal_basis: Indian Contract Act 1872 + Information Technology Act 2000 + common law of confidence
_meta.notes: NDA / Confidentiality Agreement is enforceable under Indian Contract Act if consideration + lawful object. Remedies: injunction (Specific Relief Act S.36-42) + damages. Confidentiality survives termination - not hit by S.27. Niranjan Shankar Golikari recognised trade secret protection.

title: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)

purpose.title: Purpose of disclosure (e.g., evaluation of business opportunity)

mandatory_clauses.title: Recitals / Background
mandatory_clauses.content: WHEREAS the parties wish to explore {{purpose}} (the 'Purpose'); AND WHEREAS in connection with the Purpose, each party may disclose to the other certain Confidential Information; NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH:

mandatory_clauses.title: Definition of Confidential Information
mandatory_clauses.content: 'Confidential Information' means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether orally, in writing, electronically, or otherwise, that is marked as confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure, including but not limited to: technical data, trade secrets, know-how, source code, business plans, financial information, customer lists, supplier information, designs, drawings, formulas, processes, and any derivatives.

mandatory_clauses.title: Exclusions from Confidential Information
mandatory_clauses.content: Confidential Information shall not include information that: (a) is or becomes publicly known through no breach of this Agreement; (b) was already known to the Receiving Party at the time of disclosure as evidenced by written records; (c) is rightfully received from a third party without obligation of confidentiality; (d) is independently developed by the Receiving Party without use of the Confidential Information; (e) is required to be disclosed by law or court order, provided Receiving Party gives prompt notice to enable Disclosing Party to seek protective order.

mandatory_clauses.title: Obligations of Receiving Party
subclauses: Apply same degree of care as for own confidential information (and no less than reasonable care)
Not reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble

mandatory_clauses.title: Permitted Disclosures
mandatory_clauses.content: Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information only to its directors, employees, and professional advisors who: (i) have a need to know for the Purpose, and (ii) are bound by written obligations of confidentiality no less stringent than this Agreement.

mandatory_clauses.title: No License or Transfer of Rights
mandatory_clauses.content: Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as granting any license, transfer, or assignment of any IP rights. All IP remains with the Disclosing Party.

mandatory_clauses.title: Term and Survival
mandatory_clauses.content: This Agreement is effective from {{effective_date}} and remains in force for {{term_years}} years. Obligations relating to trade secrets survive indefinitely.

mandatory_clauses.title: Return or Destruction of Confidential Information
mandatory_clauses.content: Upon termination or written request, Receiving Party shall within {{return_or_destroy_period_days}} days return or destroy (and certify destruction of) all Confidential Information in any form.

mandatory_clauses.title: Remedies for Breach
mandatory_clauses.content: The parties acknowledge that breach may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages are inadequate. Disclosing Party is entitled to seek injunctive relief under S.36-42 Specific Relief Act 1963 in addition to damages, indemnity, and any other legal remedies.

mandatory_clauses.title: No Representation or Warranty
mandatory_clauses.content: Confidential Information is provided 'AS IS'. No representation as to accuracy or completeness.

mandatory_clauses.title: Data Protection (DPDP Act)
mandatory_clauses.applies_when: Personal data is part of disclosed information

mandatory_clauses.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
mandatory_clauses.content: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. Courts at {{jurisdiction_city}} shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

prompt_context.system_role: You are drafting a Non-Disclosure Agreement under Indian law. Ensure clear definition of CI, standard exclusions, permitted disclosures, return/destroy, and remedies including injunctive relief.
drafting_rules: Define CI broadly but specifically tied to context.
Standard exclusions: public domain, prior knowledge, third party, independent development, legal requirement.
Permitted disclosees: need-to-know basis with back-to-back obligations.
Term typically 2-5 years; trade secrets survive indefinitely.
Express remedies clause - injunction + damages. Reference S.36-42 Specific Relief Act.
If personal data flows: include DPDP Act compliance.
Cross-border NDAs: address governing law clearly.
For employee/contractor NDAs - integrate with employment/service agreement instead.

filing_checklist: Execute in duplicate on stamp paper.
Each party retains one signed original.
Maintain log of CI disclosed (especially if marked confidential).
Track return/destruction at end of engagement.
